themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Collapse
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk conditions have spiked dramatically THIS WEEK with 65 street condition complaints (vs. 15.5 weekly average) and 16 sidewalk complaints (vs. 5.6 average), suggesting a widespread infrastructure failure or recent weather damage affecting mobility and safety across Bed-Stuy.
evidence: Street Condition complaints: 65 THIS WEEK vs. 15.5 weekly average (319% spike, z-score: 7.07)
Sidewalk Condition complaints: 16 last week vs. 5.6 weekly average (184% spike, z-score: 6.94)
Root/Sewer/Sidewalk Condition complaints: 4 last week vs. 1.0 average (300% spike, z-score: 6.0)
reporting_angles: Canvass neighborhoods to identify specific blocks with worst conditions and interview residents about safety hazards
Query DOE/DOT on what caused the spike—recent weather, deferred maintenance, or contractor work?

themes_detail.label: Missing Street Signs Epidemic
themes_detail.summary: Street sign complaints have exploded to 3 complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average—a 2300% spike (z-score 8.69)—indicating either coordinated theft, vandalism, or a systemic infrastructure removal affecting navigation and public safety across the district.
evidence: Street Sign - Missing complaints: 3 THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69, highest statistical severity)
Spike is acute and concentrated in current week
No prior pattern suggests this is a sudden new phenomenon
reporting_angles: Investigate whether signs are being stolen for scrap metal or deliberately removed; check NYPD complaint data for related theft reports
Identify which intersections/corridors are most affected and document with photos for city follow-up

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints spiked to 6 THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average (500% increase, z-score 7.07), signaling either coordinated illegal cutting, storm damage, or contractor negligence affecting the canopy and green space in Bed-Stuy.
evidence: Illegal Tree Damage complaints: 6 THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly average (500% spike, z-score: 7.07)
Spike is very recent and concentrated
May correlate with recent storm activity or construction projects (795 DOB permits filed in last 90 days, including 134 new buildings)
reporting_angles: Identify which blocks have been hit hardest; cross-reference with active construction permits to see if contractors are responsible
Interview residents and local environmental groups about tree loss and canopy concerns

themes_detail.label: Sanitation and Litter Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Dirty condition complaints peaked 2 weeks ago at 113 (212% spike, z-score 6.92 vs. 36.2 average), and litter basket requests hit 7 (600% spike, z-score 6.0 vs. 1.0 average) in the same period, indicating a sanitation system failure or lack of waste infrastructure.
evidence: Dirty Condition complaints: 113 two weeks ago vs. 36.2 weekly average (212% spike, z-score: 6.92)
Litter Basket Request complaints: 7 two weeks ago vs. 1.0 weekly average (600% spike, z-score: 6.0)
Community Board has repeated budget requests for 'enhanced health and safety inspections' suggesting chronic underservice
reporting_angles: Investigate whether sanitation department staffing or collection routes changed two weeks ago; check for labor actions or service reductions
Interview residents and business owners about visibility and impacts; determine which neighborhoods are worst-hit

themes_detail.label: Vacant Lot Proliferation
themes_detail.summary: Lot condition complaints spiked to 4 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score 5.67), suggesting neglected or abandoned properties may be accumulating, which aligns with long-standing community board requests for property maintenance and code enforcement.
evidence: Lot Condition complaints: 4 last week vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% spike, z-score: 5.67)
5 active ULURP applications in pipeline including 1166 Bedford Avenue, 862-868 Kent Avenue, and others suggest speculative holding and development pressure
795 DOB permits filed in last 90 days (485 alterations, 134 new buildings) indicate active market but also potential for vacant properties
reporting_angles: Map vacant lots against ULURP applications to see if properties are being held speculatively; interview residents about blight
Check HPD and DOF records for tax delinquency and ownership patterns in these lots
